articles.summary: 58-card stat primer: life, shield, mana, resistances, defenses, buffs, statuses, damage forms, ailments, Spell Burst, Multistrike, Command, Growth.
findings: Resistance cap 75%, raisable to 95%; every resistance loses 20% at Lv.48, 58 and 80.
Armor reduction tops out at 80%; non-physical gets 60% of it.
Evasion rate clamped 0-75%; hero hits never miss monsters.
Block chance cap 100%; block ratio 35% base, 75% max; mitigation per source caps at 90%.
Attack and cast speed each cap at 30 per second.
unknowns: No patch/version stated; correspondence to the current client is unverified.
Affliction card is self-contradictory: +1% DoT taken per point with a 100-point cap, yet a 50% ceiling at 100 points.
Spell evasion 'drops by an additional 40%': multiplicative (x0.6) or flat points is not stated.
Life/Mana base lines do not say whether the per-level term counts level 1, nor how flat gains order against % bonuses.
Critical-chance formula divides rating by 100 without stating the unit (percent vs fraction).
Multistrike per-attack increment: additive or compounding is not stated.
Command decay wording (13/s, +7/s per 10 Command) is ambiguous about step boundaries.
Resistance Penetration and Damage Conversion each appear twice (defender and attacker views); the Mana card carries an orphan heading about Max Energy Shield rules with no content.
Monster accuracy ceiling stated as 1,247 here; the Monster page attr tab tops out at 680 'hit', relationship unresolved.

articles.title: Skill - Support Skill - Help
articles.summary: Two Help tabs: nine support-skill cards (energy, passives, sealing, auras, curses, empower, triggers, casting) and a general skill-slot rule list; position 25 is that second tab.
findings: An active skill takes at most 5 supports.
Energy from levels and non-trinket gear unlocks slots; each tab's first slot opens itself at the energy cap.
One curse per monster unless gear or talents lift it.
Sealing reserves mana or life without lowering the maximum.
Equipping two identical skills: only one works.
unknowns: No energy amounts, slot costs or seal percentages given.
How Mana Cost Multiplier and Sealed Mana % combine is not explained.
Path of Progression /48 tab is a reward data list, not Help text.
No version stated.

assumptions: More links require spending energy

articles.title: Talent - Help
articles.summary: Three data tabs (professions, core nodes, talents) plus two Help tabs on talent points, node kinds, panel selection and resets.
findings: Four panels: first from six basic, second from that basic's four advanced, last two unrestricted.
One point per level, plus key quests or Hunter's Forge.
A core slot opens after enough nodes in that panel; the active core is switchable anytime.
Resets are free before Lv.80 per one card, before Lv.90 per the other; Elixir of Oblivion supplies Oblivion Points.
unknowns: Free-reset level conflicts (80 vs 90) between the two Help tabs.
Node taxonomy differs: Micro/Medium/Lv.1 Core/Lv.2 Core vs Minor/Medium/Legendary Medium/Core.
Point thresholds for core slots and total point counts are not given.
No version stated.

assumptions: Quest and Hunter's Forge amounts not given

formulas.expression: resetCost = 0 below level L, L in {80, 90}
assumptions: Two cards disagree on L

articles.title: Core Talent Node - Help
articles.summary: Single short card; same text as the core-node card on the Talent page.
findings: Activation needs enough points invested in its own panel; the chosen core can be swapped at any time.
unknowns: Required point threshold not given.
No version stated.

articles.title: Hero Trait - Help
articles.summary: One short card: traits set a hero's fighting style; branches open by level, and clicking a trait icon fires its special ability.
findings: Branch choice is gated by level requirements.
unknowns: No level thresholds, trait ranks, trait-level scaling or +Hero Trait Level rules are given.
No version stated.

articles.title: Reward - Help
articles.summary: One card: rewards differ by map and mode and fall into five rarity tiers.
findings: Tier order, lowest first: Common, Fine, Precious, Rare, Ultimate.
unknowns: No drop rates, quantities, multipliers or tier-selection rules.
Fourth tier is 'Rare' here but 'Matchless' in the Gear page's Legendary rarity list.
No version stated.

articles.title: Gear - Item Level - Help
articles.summary: Help tab with four cards (item level, affix tier, energy, Legendary rarity) plus a progression-rewards data tab.
findings: Map level rises through the story; higher maps drop higher item level, which improves odds of rare crafted affixes.
A stronger affix grade unlocks every 10 item levels.
Energy needs enough item level; weapons and chests give most, trinkets none.
Legendary rarity: Common, Fine, Precious, Matchless, Ultimate, shown by drop-frame color.
unknowns: Item-level boundaries for affix grades and the Energy threshold are not given.
No probability numbers for rare affixes.
No version stated.

formulas.expression: affixGradeUnlocked steps up once per 10 item levels
assumptions: Offset (e.g. 1-10 vs 0-9) and tier count not given

articles.title: Monster - Monster Rarity - Help
articles.summary: One Help card on monster rarity plus two raw data tabs (per-level attributes, per-rarity multipliers).
findings: Five rarities: Normal, Magic, Rare, Legendary boss, Supreme boss.
Elites are Rare plus both boss kinds; bosses are Legendary plus Supreme.
Data tab, not Help text: experience column reads 1, 3.5, 5.5, 100, 100 for rarity ids 1-5; no drop columns.
unknowns: Rarity ids in the data tab are not mapped to names on the page; column semantics (multiplier vs bonus) undocumented.
attr tab (levels 1-200: hit, dodge, physical_damage) plateaus from about Lv.89-90; dodge drops to 114 there, unexplained.
Help text gives no loot or XP numbers.
No version stated.

formulas.domain: monster experience by rarity id (data tab)
assumptions: Name mapping of ids and whether the value is a multiplier are not stated

articles.title: Enchant - Help
articles.summary: One short Help card plus a 334-row enchant data tab.
findings: Enchanting adds effects to gear through fixed recipes and consumables.
Recipes unlock with level.
Data tab, not Help text: rows carry quality grades with material costs and level unlocks.
unknowns: Help text gives no costs, slots or limits.
No version stated.

articles.title: Gear Empowerment - Help
articles.summary: Two Help tabs about re-rolling a gear piece's Energy value.
findings: Only gear with an Energy bar qualifies; each attempt spends Energy Cores.
Result lands inside the item's Energy range; higher item level favors higher values.
Items already at the range maximum cannot be empowered further.
unknowns: Core cost, Energy ranges and roll distribution are not given.
No version stated.

formulas.expression: newEnergy in [energyMin(item), energyMax(item)]; blocked when energy == energyMax
assumptions: Distribution skews upward with item level (no numbers)

articles.title: Trade House - Help
articles.summary: Three cards: buying with several currencies, seller booths, and advanced search.
findings: Selling requires an unlocked booth; booth count is capped.
Advanced search covers non-Legendary gear only.
unknowns: Booth cap, fees and accepted currencies are not given.
No version stated.

articles.title: Fluorescent Memory - Exchange - Help
articles.summary: Exchange Help card, a rule card, and a 32-row exchange data tab.
findings: Memories drop in Netherrealm; enough copies trade for items at the Trader.
Boss drop rates vary per Netherrealm map and are viewable before entering.
Exclusive kinds: plane-exclusive (in each stage's exclusive drop list) and five named gameplay-exclusive ones.
unknowns: No drop-rate numbers.
Required counts in the data tab are an unfilled %s placeholder.
Rule card repeats one line twice (likely render artifact).
No version stated.

articles.title: Corrosion Craft - Help
articles.summary: Two cards on Corrosion Craft and its seasonal materials.
findings: Targets Legendary or Rare gear with at least 4 affixes; once per item.
Uses Aemberon Cores or Familiar Nexuses from seasonal content; the story grants one free try.
Corroded Rare gear stays craftable and enchantable, but crafting costs double.
Defiled (two affixes +1-2 rank) requires Familiar Cores.
unknowns: Materials card says Familiar Cores while the main card says Familiar Nexuses.
Outcome list and probabilities absent; seems to describe an older seasonal system than the Corrosion page.
No version stated.

articles.title: Netherrealm - Help
articles.summary: Help tab with 14 cards plus a system card, and data tabs (unlocks, 900 drops, areas, achievements).
findings: Base map affix count changes drop quantity and rarity.
Plane boss or Traveler kill guarantees one exclusive Legendary; harder planes add exclusives at higher rates.
Compass slots at 18 Cinders; Traveler at 35, re-challenge after four plane bosses.
Beacon rank follows plane Timemark, capped at stage level.
Progress shared per account and season.
unknowns: No numeric drop-quantity or rarity effect per base affix.
Reward multiplier from Inheritance cards, awakening chance and difficulty reward scaling are unquantified.
Data tab (not Help): plane unlocks at 0, 3, 8, 15, 24 Cinders; the drops tab lists items without rates.
Four-phase structure may not match the current season; no version stated.

assumptions: Function shape and values not given
Page says 'typically', so exceptions may exist

formulas.expression: compassSlots unlock at cinders >= 18; Traveler unlock at cinders >= 35

articles.summary: Five cards on Netherrealm side events, Mystery Chest/Chest Mimic and four god Trials, plus an achievements data tab.
findings: Each event can appear in any Netherrealm stage; a stage may hold one Trial of a given kind.
Rewards scale with kills before time runs out (War, kills add time), survival time (Might), defended waves (Machines) or chosen trial rarity (Hunting).
Each mode names four exclusive Legendaries it may drop.
unknowns: No spawn chances, reward-level steps or drop chances.
No version stated.

formulas.expression: rewards = increasing f(kills | survivalTime | wavesDefended | trialRarity)
assumptions: Only monotonic direction is stated

articles.title: Exchange - Help
articles.summary: Two cards: gear salvage and the Black Market.
findings: Unneeded gear converts to Flame Residue at the Trader; enough Residue becomes Flame Dust.
Exchange Proofs buy Rare gear; a Black Gold refresh rerolls the list and grants 2 Proofs.
unknowns: Residue-to-Dust ratio, refresh cost and Proof prices not given.
No version stated.

formulas.expression: refresh(Black Gold) -> new list + 2 Exchange Proofs
assumptions: Black Gold cost not given

articles.title: Hero Ranking
articles.summary: Two cards on the in-game Hero Ranking board.
findings: Opened from the menu; shows strong players' skills, talents and gear, filterable by hero, skill and gear.
Intended to reflect hero and school popularity.
unknowns: Ranking criteria, refresh cadence and any data/export interface are not documented; no server routes are implied.
No version stated.

articles.title: Craft
articles.summary: Craft Help card plus a gear-type filter card and a 2,526-row affix data tab.
findings: Non-Legendary gear only, at Arms Dealer Geely after story unlock.
Adds or replaces an affix in a chosen slot from a chosen pool, paying Embers and Flame Fuel.
Pools: Basic, Advanced, Ultimate; Ultimate needs Priceless gear; at most 2 Advanced and 2 Ultimate per item.
Truth Embers reroll all random affix values.
unknowns: 'Priceless' is not defined against the rarity names on other pages.
Costs and affix weights are not in the Help text.
No version stated.

assumptions: Ultimate only on Priceless gear

articles.title: Corrosion
articles.summary: Corrosion Help card plus effect and base-affix data tabs.
findings: Once per item, at The Lightless Zenoth; Darkness or Darkest variants.
Outcomes: Mutate (random Aember base affixes), Chaos (value reroll, tiers kept), Arrogant (one affix +1-2 tiers), Void (no change); Darkest adds Desecration (two affixes +1-2 tiers).
Vorax gear has five own outcomes; Chaos, Void or Fester bind the item.
unknowns: Outcome probabilities absent.
Effect data tab differs: Arrogance and Desecration upgrade by 1 tier there, plus Mutation/Chaos variants not in the Help text.
No version stated.

assumptions: Distribution of 1 vs 2 not stated
Data tab says +1 tier for Arrogance/Desecration
